chapterInfo.content:
11
Teefoɔ ahotɔ ne abɔnefoɔ ahoyera
1 # Mmb 16.11; 20.10; Lew 19.35 Nsisie nsania yɛ AWURADE akyiwadeɛ,
na abrammo a ɛtene no yɛ no anisɔ.
2 # Mmb 16.18; 18.12 Ahantan ba a, na aniwuo ba,
na ahobrɛasefoɔ na nyansa ne wɔn teɛ.
3 # Dwom 52.5 Teefoɔ pɛyɛ bɛgya wɔn,
na nkontompofoɔ nnaadaa bɛsɛe wɔn.
4 # Mmb 10.2 Adedodoɔ nyɛ mma hwee abufuo da,
na tenenee gye onipa firi owuo mu.
5Pɛyɛfoɔ tenenee bɛtene ne kwan,
na ɔbɔnefoɔ deɛ ɔbɛhwe ase n’abɔnefosɛm mu.
6Teefoɔ tenenee bɛgye wɔn,
na nkontompofoɔ deɛ mmusubɔ mu na wɔbɛkye wɔn.
7 # Mmb 10.28 Onipa bɔne wu a, n’anidasoɔ yera,
na amumuyɛfoɔ kwanhwɛ yera.
8 # Mmb 21.18; Yes 43.3 Wɔbɛyi ɔteneneeni afiri ahohiahia mu,
na ɔbɔnefoɔ abɛsi n’ananmu ahunu amane.
9Ɔdebɔneyɛni de n’ano sɛe ne yɔnko,
na teneneefoɔ nimdeɛ na wɔde bɛyi wɔn.
10Teneneefoɔ di yie a, ɔman ho sane wɔn,
na abɔnefoɔ sɛe a, wɔhuro.
11 # Mmb 28.12; 29.2 Ɛnam teefoɔ nhyira so na wɔma kuro soɔ,
na ɛnam abɔnefoɔ anomu nsɛm so na wɔbɔ no.
12Deɛ ɔyi ne yɔnko ahi nni ti,
na nhunumu nipa mua n’ano.
13Nsekuni nenam yi ahuntasɛm adi,
na nokorɛ honhom kata asɛm so.
14Deɛ akwankyerɛ nnie no, ɔman hwe ase,
na ɔmannwoeɛ wɔ agyinatufoɔ dodoɔ mu.
15 # Mmb 6.1-2 Deɛ ɔdi hɔhoɔ agyinamu no, ɛbɛwie no bɔne,
na deɛ ɔtane agyinamudeɛ no aso mu dwo no.
16Ɔbaa a n’anim teɛ nya animuonyam,
na ɔhoɔdenfoɔ deɛ ɔnya ahonyadeɛ kwa.
17Ɔyamyiefoɔ yɛ ne kra yie,
na otirimuɔdenfoɔ ha ɔno ara ne honam.
18Ɔbɔnefoɔ yɛ adwuma hunu,
na deɛ ɔgu tenenee no nya nokorɛ akatua.
19 # Mmb 19.23 Deɛ ɔtim tenenee mu no kɔ nkwa mu,
na deɛ ɔti bɔne no nya owuo.
20AWURADE akyiwadeɛ ne akoma kontonkyifoɔ,
na wɔn a wɔn kwan yɛ pɛ sɔ n’ani.
21Ampa ara, ɔbɔnefoɔ renni bem.
Na teneneefoɔ asefoɔ deɛ, wɔbɛgye wɔn.
22 # Mmb 31.30 Sɛ sika adwinneɛ teɛ wɔ prako hwene mu no,
sɛ ɔbaabereɛ a wapo deɛ ɛfata teɛ ne no.
23 # Mmb 11.7 Teneneefoɔ adeɛ a wɔpɛ yɛ papa nko ara,
na abɔnefoɔ deɛ anidasoɔ dane wɔn abufuo.
24Obi wɔ hɔ a ɔpete, nanso ɔkɔ so dɔre ara,
na obi di adɔna tra so, nanso ɛhia no ara.
25 # Mmb 19.17 Nhyira kra bɛdɔre sradeɛ,
na deɛ ɔma ebinom meeɛ nso bɛmee.
26Deɛ ɔkora aburoo no, nkurɔfoɔ dome no,
na nhyira ba deɛ ɔtɔn no so.
27Deɛ ɔpɛ papa akyiri kwan no hwehwɛ anisɔ,
na deɛ ɔdi bɔne akyire no, ɛba ne so.
28 # Dwom 52.7-8 Deɛ ɔde ne ho to n’ahonyadeɛ soɔ no bɛhwe ase,
na ateneneefoɔ bɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm sɛ ahahan.
29Deɛ ɔha ne fie bɛdi mframa,
na ogyimifoɔ bɛyɛ akoma mu nyansafoɔ akoa.
30 # Mmb 3.18; 15.4 Ɔteneneeni aba yɛ nkwa dua,
na onyansafoɔ deɛ ɔnya akra.#11.30 Tete atwerɛ a wɔgye to mu binom ka no sɛ: Na mmaratofoɔ sɛe akra.
31 # 1 Pe 4.17-18 Hwɛ, sɛ wɔtua ɔteneneeni ka asase so a,
na nkantom ɔbɔnefoɔ ne omumuyɛfoɔ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Nsisie nsania yɛ AWURADE akyiwadeɛ,
na abrammo a ɛtene no yɛ no anisɔ.
Ahantan ba a, na aniwuo ba,
na ahobrɛasefoɔ na nyansa ne wɔn teɛ.
Teefoɔ pɛyɛ bɛgya wɔn,
na nkontompofoɔ nnaadaa bɛsɛe wɔn.
Adedodoɔ nyɛ mma hwee abufuo da,
na tenenee gye onipa firi owuo mu.
Pɛyɛfoɔ tenenee bɛtene ne kwan,
na ɔbɔnefoɔ deɛ ɔbɛhwe ase n’abɔnefosɛm mu.
Teefoɔ tenenee bɛgye wɔn,
na nkontompofoɔ deɛ mmusubɔ mu na wɔbɛkye wɔn.
Onipa bɔne wu a, n’anidasoɔ yera,
na amumuyɛfoɔ kwanhwɛ yera.
Wɔbɛyi ɔteneneeni afiri ahohiahia mu,
na ɔbɔnefoɔ abɛsi n’ananmu ahunu amane.
Ɔdebɔneyɛni de n’ano sɛe ne yɔnko,
na teneneefoɔ nimdeɛ na wɔde bɛyi wɔn.
Teneneefoɔ di yie a, ɔman ho sane wɔn,
na abɔnefoɔ sɛe a, wɔhuro.
Ɛnam teefoɔ nhyira so na wɔma kuro soɔ,
na ɛnam abɔnefoɔ anomu nsɛm so na wɔbɔ no.
Deɛ ɔyi ne yɔnko ahi nni ti,
na nhunumu nipa mua n’ano.
Nsekuni nenam yi ahuntasɛm adi,
na nokorɛ honhom kata asɛm so.
Deɛ akwankyerɛ nnie no, ɔman hwe ase,
na ɔmannwoeɛ wɔ agyinatufoɔ dodoɔ mu.
Deɛ ɔdi hɔhoɔ agyinamu no, ɛbɛwie no bɔne,
na deɛ ɔtane agyinamudeɛ no aso mu dwo no.
Ɔbaa a n’anim teɛ nya animuonyam,
na ɔhoɔdenfoɔ deɛ ɔnya ahonyadeɛ kwa.
Ɔyamyiefoɔ yɛ ne kra yie,
na otirimuɔdenfoɔ ha ɔno ara ne honam.
Ɔbɔnefoɔ yɛ adwuma hunu,
na deɛ ɔgu tenenee no nya nokorɛ akatua.
Deɛ ɔtim tenenee mu no kɔ nkwa mu,
na deɛ ɔti bɔne no nya owuo.
AWURADE akyiwadeɛ ne akoma kontonkyifoɔ,
na wɔn a wɔn kwan yɛ pɛ sɔ n’ani.
Ampa ara, ɔbɔnefoɔ renni bem.
Na teneneefoɔ asefoɔ deɛ, wɔbɛgye wɔn.
Sɛ sika adwinneɛ teɛ wɔ prako hwene mu no,
sɛ ɔbaabereɛ a wapo deɛ ɛfata teɛ ne no.
Teneneefoɔ adeɛ a wɔpɛ yɛ papa nko ara,
na abɔnefoɔ deɛ anidasoɔ dane wɔn abufuo.
Obi wɔ hɔ a ɔpete, nanso ɔkɔ so dɔre ara,
na obi di adɔna tra so, nanso ɛhia no ara.
Nhyira kra bɛdɔre sradeɛ,
na deɛ ɔma ebinom meeɛ nso bɛmee.
Deɛ ɔkora aburoo no, nkurɔfoɔ dome no,
na nhyira ba deɛ ɔtɔn no so.
Deɛ ɔpɛ papa akyiri kwan no hwehwɛ anisɔ,
na deɛ ɔdi bɔne akyire no, ɛba ne so.
Deɛ ɔde ne ho to n’ahonyadeɛ soɔ no bɛhwe ase,
na ateneneefoɔ bɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm sɛ ahahan.
Deɛ ɔha ne fie bɛdi mframa,
na ogyimifoɔ bɛyɛ akoma mu nyansafoɔ akoa.
Ɔteneneeni aba yɛ nkwa dua,
na onyansafoɔ deɛ ɔnya akra.
Hwɛ, sɛ wɔtua ɔteneneeni ka asase so a,
na nkantom ɔbɔnefoɔ ne omumuyɛfoɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
